proposals.evidence: User accepts ksara for these reduced ash forms. Preserve uncertainty about liquid loss and the source glottalization; the alternative khak comparison is not selected. Earlier audit: Full kṣāra 3674 documents khār/chār alkali and ash, but the reduced kh-forms lack evidence for the lost liquid and may also invite comparison with regional khāk ash/dust. No supported immediate donor or diagnostic local development establishes the choice yet. Hold the competing analysis and preserve glottalization/hiatus spellings; do not treat this as only uncertainty about IA borrowing. This previous hold is resolved by explicit user editorial choice on 2026-09-15; its evidential qualifications remain.
